title: Tokens Removed from Binance Alpha for Technical Incompatibility
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians ,  As part of our ongoing efforts to ensure a smooth and secure trading experience for Binance users, we regularly review tokens’ compatibility with our system. Following a recent review, we identified that some tokens implement a “transfer taxes” function (fees deducted during transactions) that would create inconsistencies in how tokens are processed within Binance. These mechanisms currently are not supported and may affect transaction accuracy. To protect users and ensure system integrity, tokens that do not meet our current technical requirements will be removed from Binance Alpha on  2025-04-17 11:00 (UTC),  including: GOUT GAME / GAMEAI If users hold any of the aforementioned token(s), they can still sell them via their Binance Exchange Alpha Accounts even after the tokens are removed from Binance Alpha.  Binance is actively in contact with the relevant project teams and will explore solutions where possible. Thank you for your understanding and continued support. Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-04-17
